digest.component_or_area: Application-wide operation-scoped configuration and provider authentication composition
propositions: Configuration must resolve once at operation boundary with precedence: explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, and must remain immutable for the duration of that operation without rereading ambient state.

Provider-native authentication (LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, op-cert) must be injected exclusively through subsystem-local factories and existing RP-01 ProviderSession path, preserving budget, retry history, cache, tracing, usage, and failure behavior.

Static credentials must be represented using provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic carriers and revealed only in sending adapters; credentials must never appear in repr, serialization, snapshots, logs, argv, or subprocess environment.

Same-capability children inherit ambient environment; owning children receive only their adapter overlay; unrelated siblings must have exact Rebar-declared secret names removed from inherited environment.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before service work, store in a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 files, and observe changes only after restart.

AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject unauthorized reads below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover.
